answers.core: Yes, this should be in the core. It’s a small UI button that would help many users who run into the same situation. They wouldn’t need to search the internet or install a plugin just to access this basic workflow improvement, the button would already be there, built into the editor.
answers.workaround: Yes, and I’ve even made a plugin for it already, but it has some limitations. For example, the title of the selected item still changes even when the Inspector is locked. A native solution would likely be the ideal approach.

title: Add a "lock" button to lock the Inspector onto a specific item.
